root_cause: The installed-payload test selected every regular file whose path ended with a binary suffix. The suffix /plasma-discover matched both the real /usr/bin/plasma-discover ELF and /usr/share/lintian/overrides/plasma-discover, which is a text file. Passing that text file to ldd caused exit status 1. sbuild, lintian, the unchanged CategoriesTest, and the real Ubuntu-to-SupraLINUX seven-binary upgrade all passed; this is a DEP-8 target-selection false negative, not a runtime payload failure.
repair_scope: Autopkgtest only. Keep KDE source, compiled runtime payload, Qt, Frameworks, package split and the revision4 private-library loader-context rule unchanged. For each expected binary suffix, require exactly one installed file with ELF magic 0x7f454c46 before invoking ldd. A colliding text path may not satisfy or fail an ELF target.
